and [[Chief executive officer|Managing Director]] (CMD) is assisted by two executive directors. The [[board of directors]] consists of two representatives from the Government of India, two independent directors and the CMD.{{Citation needed|date=February 2026}} ==Operations== EdCIL has been primarily working in the domain of [[online assessment]], educational infrastructure and [[procurement]], [[digital education]], and preparation of [[Project Plan Document|Detailed Project Report (DPR)]] for educational institutions. It has laid down blueprints for majority of eminent engineering and management institutions of India namely [[Indian Institutes of Technology|IITs]], [[Indian Institutes of Management|IIMs]], and [[Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research|IISERs]].{{Cite web|last=IIT|first=Guwahati|date=20 November 2020|title=Director Government of India has designated EdCIL to implement Study in India educational campaign.{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2019-11-23|title=The Saturday Interview – We should have 2 academic education.{{Cite web|title=Scholarships : "Study in India" Programme – EdCIL (India) Limited|url=https://eoi.gov.in/kabul/?8024?000|access-date=2020-11-19|website=eoi.gov.in}} EdCIL has worked for providing consultancy to [[Asian Development Bank]] (ADB). Previously, it had completed projects in various countries including Tanzania, Zanzibar, Rwanda and Ghana.{{Cite web|date=2012-02-05|title=Offering education consultancy, technical help across the extract: EdCIL (India) Limited or simply EdCIL (earlier known as Educational Consultants India Limited) is a Public Sector Undertaking in India under the administrative control of the Ministry of Education, India. It is a Miniratna-I category company. EdCIL offers management and consultancy services in all areas of education and human resource development, both within India and overseas.
